unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #15 "Optional Nano (XNO) settlement chain: the block is the enforcement receipt, so spend verification can be re-derived publicly". Argued the duplicate-authorization guard and mandate-bound payee map directly to a Nano append-only chain where every block names its prior; fail-closed stays intact — only the settle step gets a source chain where the receipt IS the ledger entry. Offered the live Vend endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/status, 0.0001 XNO) to test budget-reserve -> XNO send -> block re-read end to end. Public research disclosed.
